videos.headline: Wieneke makes unbelievable one-handed catch off deflection
videos.description: Taryn Christion's pass is deflected by a JMU defender, but Jake Wieneke concentrates to come down with the one-handed catch.

videos.headline: James Madison recovers in red zone after South Dakota State miscue
videos.description: South Dakota State quarterback Taryn Christion loses his grip on the ball as he throws, allowing the Dukes to recover in scoring position.

videos.headline: James Madison strikes first on Schor-Stapleton connection
videos.description: Dukes quarterback Bryan Schor throws a beautiful ball to Riley Stapleton, who makes the 2-yard catch in traffic as James Madison goes up 7-0.

videos.headline: South Dakota State turns it over a fourth time in first quarter
videos.description: South Dakota State quarterback Taryn Christion is sacked by Darrious Carter and loses the ball as the Dukes recover a fourth first-quarter turnover.

videos.headline: South Dakota State ties game on play-action strike
videos.description: South Dakota Sate's Taryn Christion draws the defense in with a play-action fake and finds Jake Wieneke for the 9-yard score.

videos.headline: Stapleton's second score gives Dukes lead
videos.description: James Madison's Bryan Schor steps up into the pocket and delivers a beautiful ball to Riley Stapleton for his second touchdown of the day.

videos.headline: James Madison sneaks in TD before half
videos.description: James Madison quarterback Bryan Schor lines up in the shotgun, then runs up to the line to take the snap and sneak it in to go up 21-10 before halftime.

videos.headline: Marshall explodes for 65-yard TD scamper
videos.description: James Madison opens the half with a 65-yard touchdown run by Marcus Marshall to go up 28-10.

videos.headline: James Madison extends lead with TD run
videos.description: James Madison leads 42-10 following a strong 3-yard touchdown run by Taylor Woods.

videos.headline: James Madison pours it on with pick-6
videos.description: Raven Greene catches his school-record 14th-career interception and scores on the return as James Madison leads 51-10.

videos.headline: Goedert shows NFL skill set on fade TD
videos.description: Dallas Goedert puts his size and athleticism on display coming down with the 5-yard TD while South Dakota State trails 51-16.
